about_the_game:
Ready for the ultimate battle? The monkeys are on the move—and they’re after your precious bananas! In this heart-pounding clicker game, it’s your mission to defend your valuable stash from relentless waves of cunning, lightning-fast primates. Each monkey has unique abilities that keep the action intense, unpredictable, and wildly exciting.

Step into a world of chaos and strategy with 3 unique game modes, ranging from survival to thrilling online battles. Challenge yourself across 3 beautifully crafted levels, each with its own style, obstacles, and dangers. Defeat 8 formidable monkey enemies, each with their own attack patterns, and face off against 2 epic bosses that will push your skills to the limit.

Unleash 2 powerful special abilities to turn the tide when things get hectic, and collect unique skins for both your bananas and monkeys to show off your battlefield flair. Complete your experience with exclusive profile icons that let you express your identity as a true banana guardian.

Play solo, team up in co-op, or take on real players in the intense online Versus Mode. Earn rewards through daily missions, and dive into weekly events that keep the challenges fresh and the action non-stop.

Protect your bananas. Dominate the jungle. The battle has begun—are you ready?
